shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json
git log --oneline -5 && git status --short
ls -la app lib __agent_eval__ && echo "--- next.config ---" && cat next.config.ts && echo "--- tsconfig ---" && cat tsconfig.json
node -e "console.log(require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version)" && echo "--- next/cache exports ---" && cat node_modules/next/cache.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -50

grep -rn "cacheComponents\|useCache\|dynamicIO" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "=== server-config ==="; grep -rno "cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head
cat node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/revalidate.d.ts
sed -n '55,75p' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.d.ts; echo "=== is cacheComponents top-level? ==="; sed -n '880,900p' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts
grep -n "function revalidateTag" -A 25 node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/revalidate.js | head -45
grep -rn "max\s*:" -B2 -A8 node_modules/next/dist/lib/cache-life.js 2>/dev/null | head -60 || find node_modules/next/dist -name "*cache-life*" | head
grep -o "cacheLife(profile: '[a-z]*')" node_modules/next/cache.d.ts | sort -u
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -40
(npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3111/ ; tail -5 /tmp/next.log

cd /tmp && curl -s http://localhost:3111/ -o page.html && echo "=== catalog line ===" && grep -o 'revision [0-9]*[^<]*' page.html | head -3 && echo "=== action id ===" && grep -o '\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]*' page.html | head -3 && echo "=== form tag ===" && grep -o '<form[^>]*>' page.html | head -3
node /tmp/verify.mjs

cd /tmp && curl -s http://localhost:3111/ -o after.html && echo "prices now:" && grep -o '"\$\$","[0-9]*"' after.html | head -6 && echo "stock now:" && grep -o 'tabular-nums"},"children":[0-9]*' after.html | head -6 && echo "=== sync line ===" && grep -o 'revision \\\\",1[^"]*' after.html | head -2
echo "=== deprecation / cache warnings in server log ===" ; grep -iE "deprecat|revalidate-tag-single-arg|warn|error" /tmp/next.log || echo "(none)"
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET #$i: %{time_total}s\n" http://localhost:3111/; done
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; echo "server stopped"; cat /workspace/.gitignore; echo "=== git status ==="; git status --short

sleep 1; curl -s -m 2 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3111/ || echo "server down"; echo "--- gitignore ---"; cat /workspace/.gitignore; echo "--- git status ---"; git -C /workspace status --short
git -C /workspace diff tsconfig.json
npx tsc --noEmit && echo "TYPECHECK OK" && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -18
git -C /workspace diff --stat tsconfig.json; echo "--- status ---"; git -C /workspace status --short
